purpose: Find conspicuous model-relative DiT failures dominated by blur, fusion, or limb/object topology errors rather than mild local detail defects.

primary_failures: obvious subject or major-region blur below the same-class cohort
fused or duplicated bodies, limbs, heads, wheels, frames, or objects
impossible attachment, pose, count, or large-part topology
gross spatial misalignment between interacting major components
exclude_as_primary_bad: a recognizable and coherent sample that merely lacks photographic realism
a mild local detail issue when the full sample remains near the model's class-average quality
visual_rule.relative_requirement: A discovery candidate must be plainly below its 20-image same-class cohort, not merely imperfect in an absolute sense.

selection_boundary.candidate_use: engineering discovery only until independent model-relative review is completed
